title: Carlo Ancelotti praises India's fighting spirit, hails Brazil's new talent
description:
Brazilian head coach Carlo Ancelotti was impressed by India's "organised" defense  and counter-attacking approach but said his team  found it "easier" to control the game after breaking the deadlock in its 4-0 win in the historic football friendly here on Saturday.
Playing under muggy conditions with a rejigged side, the five-time world champions had to navigate some anxious moments in the first 27 minutes before Estevao (28th), Pedro (42nd) and Samuel Lino (58th, 90+5) secured a comfortable win over world No. 138 India.
"They defended, they were organised, they tried to play counter-attack. I think they played a good game," Ancelotti said of India in the post-match interaction.
The Italian great felt the opening goal changed the complexion of the contest.
"We had difficulty to open the score but the moment we opened the score with Estevao, we had more opportunity to control better the game," he said.
